brandName.title: Brand Name
brandName.description: Name of the brand or company conducting the fit analysis (1-100 characters).

criteria.title: Brand Fit Criteria
criteria.description: Detailed prompt or list of criteria to evaluate the influencer against (10-10,000 characters).
criteria.example:
Must have lived in Dallas for >3 years.
Went to High School or College in target city.
Is younger than 35.
Has more than 10K followers.
criteria.prefill:
Must have lived in Dallas for >3 years.
Went to High School or College in target city.
Is younger than 35.
Has more than 10K followers.
Has an engaging voice and creates authentic content.

influencerHandle.title: Influencer Handle (Optional if Evaluation ID is provided)
influencerHandle.description: Social media handle (e.g., 'natgeo' or '@natgeo'). Required if Evaluation ID is not provided.

platform.title: Platform
platform.description: Social media platform (instagram or tiktok). Defaults to 'instagram'.

evaluationId.title: Evaluation ID (Optional)
evaluationId.description: Existing evaluation ID from a previous influencer evaluation run. If provided, skips initial evaluation step.
